body.description:
The Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation with Stations (CHIRPS v3) is a 40+ year,
high-resolution quasi-global rainfall dataset. It spans 60°N to 60°S and covers all longitudes,
providing data from 1981 to near-present.
CHIRPS v3 combines satellite-based thermal infrared rainfall estimates with in-situ station observations to produce a 0.05° gridded rainfall time series over land.

The RNL version uses daily precipitation from the ECMWF ERA Reanalysis v5 (ERA5) data product
to partition pentadal CHIRPS-v3 precipitation totals into daily amounts.
For more information please see [this readme](https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/daily/readme.txt).

---

_Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation with Stations version 3 (CHIRPS3) Data Repository: https://doi.org/10.15780/G2JQ0P (2025)._
